cases.jobDescription: We are hiring a backend engineer to build AI-powered services. Must have strong Python and FastAPI experience, experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar), REST API design, and building async microservices. Nice to have: embeddings/semantic search, Docker, and AWS deployment.

resumes.name: Strong Match
resumes.text: Backend engineer with 4 years building AI services in Python. Designed and shipped async FastAPI microservices that call the OpenAI API for extraction and ranking. Built an embeddings-based semantic search feature over product data. Designed REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients. Containerized services with Docker and deployed on AWS ECS.

resumes.name: Partial Match
resumes.text: Software engineer with 3 years of Python backend experience. Built REST APIs with Flask for an internal analytics tool. Familiar with Docker for local development. Some exposure to machine learning through a university course. No production LLM or FastAPI experience yet.

resumes.name: Weak Match
resumes.text: Frontend developer with 5 years of experience in React and TypeScript. Strong CSS and UI design skills. Built responsive dashboards and design systems. Limited backend exposure; no Python, no AI/LLM work.

cases.jobDescription: Generative AI Engineering. Design and build LLM-powered microservices and workflows: conversational AI / chatbot systems, agentic workflows, and GenAI-driven product features. Build and optimize RAG pipelines end-to-end: document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval quality. Apply structured prompt engineering and systematically evaluate LLM outputs: offline evals, guardrails, and quality monitoring in production. Integrate and operate LLM APIs and open-weight models with attention to latency, cost, and reliability. Machine Learning & Data Science: build, train, and evaluate ML models where classical approaches fit better than GenAI; apply sound experimental practice with proper evaluation metrics, baselines, and error analysis; contribute across the ML lifecycle (data preparation, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring). Engineering & Production: implement services with backend and platform teams meeting performance, reliability, cost, and security expectations; follow best practices for reproducibility, observability, and maintainability; participate in code reviews and technical design. Ownership & Growth: own features end-to-end, document systems, and bring a research/experimentation mindset tracking new models, papers, and tooling.

resumes.name: Candidate A
resumes.text: SDE-2 Fullstack & AI Engineer building AI-powered products, scalable backend systems, and delightful user experiences. 4.5 years across backend, frontend, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems. Recent focus: production-grade RAG pipelines, semantic search, recommendation engines, multi-agent AI workflows, and developer productivity tooling. Owns products end-to-end from problem identification and architecture through shipping, monitoring, and data-driven improvement. Experience (Amber, 2024-Present): built production AI systems including semantic search, RAG pipelines, recommendation engines, and multi-agent workflows; designed scalable backend APIs using Ruby on Rails, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS; built hybrid search using PgVector, BM25, reranking, and semantic caching to improve search quality and latency; developed AI-powered lead qualification and recommendation systems; migrated backend services to AWS ECS using Docker; built background workers, event-driven jobs, and automation pipelines; implemented production observability using Grafana, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, and AWS monitoring; led AI initiatives across a six-member engineering pod. Earlier (Torinit, 2022-2024): scalable web apps with React, TypeScript, Redux, Material UI, Node.js; reusable frontend architecture; REST API integration; CRM features; monitoring with Rollbar and LogRocket. Education: MSc and BSc in Computer Science.

resumes.name: Candidate B
resumes.text: AI/ML Engineer. AI Search & RAG Architecture: developed an AI-powered search and summarization feature for the Barclays mobile application using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to deliver contextual, accurate, grounded responses. Built scalable backend APIs using Python and AWS Lambda for AI-driven search workflows; integrated Amazon Kendra for intelligent enterprise document retrieval; implemented embedding pipelines using Amazon Titan Embeddings for semantic search; leveraged Claude Haiku for low-latency, cost-efficient LLM summarization; designed vector-based similarity search to improve relevance over keyword search; reduced hallucinations by grounding LLM outputs with retrieved context; optimized latency and cost through lightweight model selection and context control; ensured scalability using serverless and asynchronous architecture. Agentic AI: implemented orchestration workflows using LangChain for tool usage, prompt chaining, and structured LLM pipelines; designed early agentic AI patterns for modular reasoning and dynamic tool invocation; explored advanced agent architectures including Strands-based dynamic orchestration, AgentCore-style enterprise agent frameworks, and LangGraph for stateful, graph-based multi-step workflows; evaluated multi-step reasoning systems for scalable enterprise AI adoption. Impact: enabled AI-generated summaries for customer queries, improved search relevance and response accuracy, enhanced engagement and user experience, and introduced modern agentic AI capabilities into production systems.
